title: Company intelligence tools for venture-studio research
author: Michael Farzinpour
scope: A purposive comparison of 30 vendor offerings using public official documentation. Category assignments and assessments are analyst judgments.
question: Which evidence sources fit company discovery, financial diligence, demand validation, and technology or buyer research?
takeaway: Select tools by the question being answered, combine complementary evidence when needed, and trace material claims back to company or issuer sources.
observation_basis: Public official product, pricing, and documentation pages. No paid database access or hands-on product testing. Advertised capabilities are vendor claims.

records.best_for: Private-company discovery, funding histories and investor monitoring.
records.data_or_outputs: Company profiles, funding histories, investor data, alerts and exports.
records.access_evidence: Public product/pricing pages; trial signup advertised.
records.analyst_assessment: Check important funding claims against issuer sources; exhaustive category coverage was not tested.

records.best_for: Company, investor, deal and fund relationships across private capital.
records.data_or_outputs: Profiles, filtered searches, alerts, market maps, sector research and benchmarks.
records.access_evidence: Public product documentation; trial request.
records.analyst_assessment: Validate the coverage of a specific niche and the detail available in the selected package.

records.best_for: Technology-market landscapes and investment or partnership scouting.
records.data_or_outputs: Company profiles, market maps, funding/relationship data and presentation outputs.
records.access_evidence: Official indexed product pages; trial and demo advertised.
records.analyst_assessment: Vendor taxonomies may differ from a studio's category boundaries; inspect the company set manually.
records.evidence_method: Official indexed pages; direct product-page fetch was blocked.

records.best_for: Startup, investor and regional technology-ecosystem mapping.
records.data_or_outputs: Company/funding searches, market maps, watchlists, ecosystem dashboards, exports and integrations.
records.access_evidence: Public solutions/pricing pages; trial and demo advertised.
records.analyst_assessment: Technology-ecosystem emphasis may require supplements for traditional hospitality and local-service competitors.

records.best_for: Startup competitors organized by sector and business model.
records.data_or_outputs: Company/funding data, acquisitions, investor data, taxonomies, sector reports and alerts.
records.access_evidence: Public pricing; limited Lite access and sales-assisted Premium.
records.analyst_assessment: Test niche-company coverage and taxonomy fit before relying on a category map.

records.best_for: Capital-provider, fund-manager and fundraising research.
records.data_or_outputs: Institutional investors, fund managers, funds, transactions, analytics and benchmarking.
records.access_evidence: Public product documentation; demo route and separate free insights account.
records.analyst_assessment: Fund and investor information answers a different question from customer-demand validation.

records.best_for: Established U.S. private companies, including businesses without institutional funding.
records.data_or_outputs: Financial estimates, ownership, contacts, funding/M&A activity, watchlists and exports.
records.access_evidence: Public pricing; limited free Researcher access and paid plans.
records.analyst_assessment: Check estimated financials against company-reported evidence and supplement international coverage.

records.best_for: Growth and pre-IPO company research through models and interviews.
records.data_or_outputs: Company/market reports, quantitative models, interview transcripts, datasets and integrations.
records.access_evidence: Public features/pricing pages; subscription signup; pricing FAQ states no trials.
records.analyst_assessment: Growth and pre-IPO depth may be less suitable for exhaustive pre-seed competitor discovery.

records.best_for: Company financial, valuation, ownership and transaction comparisons.
records.data_or_outputs: Financials, estimates, ownership, transactions, screening, filings, charts and Office workflows.
records.access_evidence: Public product documentation; personalized demo request.
records.analyst_assessment: Broad financial workflows may exceed a small studio's needs; confirm package fit in a demo.

records.best_for: Connecting company fundamentals, markets, estimates and news.
records.data_or_outputs: Source-linked fundamentals, financial time series, estimates, Reuters news and analytics.
records.access_evidence: Public product/content documentation; details and sales-contact routes.
records.analyst_assessment: Financial-market emphasis may need a separate source for pre-seed company discovery.

records.best_for: Connecting private-company targets, deals, investors and market context.
records.data_or_outputs: Company, transaction, ownership, funding and leadership information; screens and source-linked exports.
records.access_evidence: Public product overview and demo page; commercial package terms require discussion.
records.analyst_assessment: Confirm early-stage target coverage and exact package scope before purchase.

records.best_for: Strategic questions across disclosures, analyst research and expert commentary.
records.data_or_outputs: Filings, broker research, expert transcripts, company data and cited AI analysis.
records.access_evidence: Public product/pricing documentation; sales-quoted annual subscriptions.
records.analyst_assessment: Source availability depends on the selected plan and content entitlements.

records.best_for: Comparing what public-company management teams say and publish.
records.data_or_outputs: Earnings calls, transcripts, filings, slides, keyword alerts, summaries and exports.
records.access_evidence: Public product/API/pricing documentation; Pro/API sales contact.
records.analyst_assessment: Public-company disclosures do not establish the traction of private startups.

records.best_for: Structured public-company financial comparisons.
records.data_or_outputs: Company profiles, financial statements, ratios, KPIs, stock prices and filings.
records.access_evidence: Public API reference documents endpoints and source-linked statements.
records.analyst_assessment: End-user plan terms and private-company funding coverage were not verified in accessible documentation.
records.evidence_method: Official API documentation; end-user pricing was not verified.

records.best_for: Listed-company screening, valuations and market context.
records.data_or_outputs: Equity screens, financial histories, estimates, watchlists, charts and macro dashboards.
records.access_evidence: Public pricing/plan comparisons; free and paid plans.
records.analyst_assessment: Shorter histories on free access can constrain comparisons across longer business cycles.

records.best_for: Competitor web performance, acquisition channels and audiences.
records.data_or_outputs: Traffic/channel benchmarks, keyword trends, audience insights, dashboards and alerts.
records.access_evidence: Public pricing; trial, self-service and custom business packages.
records.analyst_assessment: Website activity alone does not validate company revenue or offline customer demand.

records.best_for: Search competitors and online market visibility.
records.data_or_outputs: Competitor keywords, paid-search strategies, backlinks, traffic trends and audience comparisons.
records.access_evidence: Public product/pricing documentation; trial offers advertised.
records.analyst_assessment: Validate conversions and offline demand separately from keyword and traffic signals.

records.best_for: Search competitors, backlink relationships and organic demand signals.
records.data_or_outputs: Organic keywords/traffic, backlink profiles, competing pages and paid-search activity.
records.access_evidence: Public pricing; paid plans and limited owner-verified free access.
records.analyst_assessment: Search visibility does not establish purchases or total market revenue.

records.best_for: Where an audience directs attention and whom it follows.
records.data_or_outputs: Audience affinities, websites, podcasts, social accounts, demographics and search keywords.
records.access_evidence: Public pricing; limited free previews and paid report plans.
records.analyst_assessment: Audience affinity identifies potential channels rather than willingness to buy.

records.best_for: Mobile-app competitors and app-market growth signals.
records.data_or_outputs: Estimated downloads/revenue, active users, engagement, retention and country/category trends.
records.access_evidence: Public product documentation; signup, paid access and demo options.
records.analyst_assessment: Modeled app metrics are directional and should not be treated as audited company revenue.

records.product: Mobile App Intelligence and Data API
records.best_for: App traction, engagement and mobile competitor comparisons.
records.data_or_outputs: Estimated downloads/revenue, active users, retention, sessions, SDKs and publisher metadata.
records.access_evidence: Public API documentation; vendor signup for credentials.
records.analyst_assessment: Mobile activity estimates are a traction proxy rather than a complete company-performance measure.

records.best_for: Competing-app performance, discovery, audience and SDK signals.
records.data_or_outputs: Estimated downloads/revenue, ranks, ratings, keywords, SDKs and competitor profiles.
records.access_evidence: Public product page and free Starter plan; estimate API has plan/license conditions.
records.analyst_assessment: App-store estimates do not establish audited total company revenue.

records.best_for: Web-technology adoption and companies using selected tools.
records.data_or_outputs: Technology profiles/history, company lists, adoption signals, alerts and spreadsheet exports.
records.access_evidence: Public pricing; free individual-site lookups and paid reporting.
records.analyst_assessment: Website-stack evidence is an adoption proxy; validate commercially material deployments directly.

records.product: Technology Lookup, Lead Lists and Alerts
records.best_for: Website stacks, stack changes and technology-based company segments.
records.data_or_outputs: Detected technologies, company/contact details, segmented lead lists, alerts and API enrichment.
records.access_evidence: Public pricing; free account/sample lists; plan conditions for APIs and integrations.
records.analyst_assessment: A detected tool does not establish contract spend or depth of use.

records.best_for: Enterprise technology adoption and accounts with installed products.
records.data_or_outputs: Company/product install records, verification dates, countries, firmographics and signal intensity.
records.access_evidence: Public support documentation; official product page advertises a demo.
records.analyst_assessment: Installation-signal intensity does not establish license count or realized technology spend.
records.evidence_method: Official support documentation and indexed product-page text.

records.best_for: Buyer organizations, decision-makers and account segmentation.
records.data_or_outputs: Company/contact profiles, org charts, firmographic/technographic segments, intent and enrichment.
records.access_evidence: Official site advertises trial, Lite access, pricing and sales contact.
records.analyst_assessment: Contact/intent intelligence prioritizes outreach rather than proving commercial viability.

records.best_for: Prospect lists and company research connected to outreach.
records.data_or_outputs: Company/contact profiles, buying signals, AI account research, lists, enrichment and outreach.
records.access_evidence: Public pricing; free plan, trial and custom sales route.
records.analyst_assessment: Confirm licensing before sharing enriched data externally; standard plans are described as internal-use only.

records.best_for: B2B target accounts and decision-makers, particularly in Europe.
records.data_or_outputs: Company/contact records, filters, hiring/funding announcements, enrichment and integrations.
records.access_evidence: Public package descriptions and demo; pricing directs buyers to sales.
records.analyst_assessment: Corroborate funding-announcement signals before using them as a funding-history dataset.

records.best_for: Custom company-research questions converted to structured fields.
records.data_or_outputs: AI web-research outputs, table fields, multi-provider enrichment and account workflows.
records.access_evidence: Public pricing and trial; advanced agent access varies by plan.
records.analyst_assessment: Verify generated research and third-party enrichment before inclusion in leadership briefs.

records.product: Company Data, Enrichment and Search APIs
records.best_for: Company-list enrichment and workforce signals in custom pipelines.
records.data_or_outputs: Company profiles, resume-derived employee counts, headcount growth, APIs and licensed feeds.
records.access_evidence: Public company schema/product documentation; signup and sales routes.
records.analyst_assessment: Corroborate resume-derived headcounts before treating them as a complete workforce census.
